identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.06] Build the operator attention inbox and intervention workflow

values.review_scope: Exact #116 attention-request lifecycle, Runtime queue policy, Observatory inbox/actions, source identity authority, response semantics, restart/reconnect proof, and exclusions from #117/#279-#282.
review_prompts: Does the design prevent fabricated source identity, urgency, and authority?
Are rate limits, grouping, deduplication, quiet modes, and retention explicit enough to prevent flooding?
Do operator response states avoid implicit approval?
Does #116 remain separate from #117 and downstream proof children?
